Supreme Court to Hear Bhojshala Dispute, Congress Meets

The Supreme Court is scheduled to hear the Bhojshala dispute on Wednesday, July 29. The temple side is reportedly focused on the court's stance regarding an alternative site for Namaz. Separately, the Chhattisgarh Congress party will hold an important meeting on the same day.
